script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       g.delivery_no,
       g.gd_status,
       g.organization_id,
       CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND l.goods_delivery_id = {{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0) AS line_count,
       (SELECT p.step_name FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'GDC|{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'command', o.command, 'job_status', o.job_status, 'progress_percent', o.progress_percent,
                                             'progress_message', o.progress_message, 'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND o.is_deleted = 0
           AND ((o.correlation_id = 'GD|{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}' AND ((o.command = 'COMPLETE_GD' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT',
		'COMMITTING_GD', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW'))
                 OR (o.command = 'COMPLETE_PACKING' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PACKING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW'))
                 OR (o.command = 'EDIT_GD' AND o.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))))
                OR (o.command = 'CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM' AND o.gd_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}'
                    AND o.job_status IN ('RECONCILING_GD', 'GD_COMMITTED', 'CREATING_PICKING', 'PICKING_RETRYING', 'PICKING_READY', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')))) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(pj.id AS CHAR), 'command', pj.command, 'job_status', pj.job_status)) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job pj
         WHERE pj.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND pj.is_deleted = 0 AND pj.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING'
           AND pj.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub ti
                        WHERE ti.transfer_order_id = CAST(pj.picking_id AS UNSIGNED) AND ti.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND ti.is_deleted = 0
                          AND ti.gd_id = {{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}} AND IFNULL(ti.line_status, '') <> 'Cancelled')) AS picking_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('picking_id', CAST(t.id AS CHAR), 'picking_no', t.to_id, 'is_processing', COALESCE(t.is_processing, 0),
                                             'lock_age_sec', TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.update_time, CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')))) AS CHAR)
          FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x.transfer_order_id FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub x
                 WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.gd_id = {{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}} AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(x.line_status,
		'') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')) lo
          STRAIGHT_JOIN transfer_order t ON t.id = lo.transfer_order_id AND t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0
           AND COALESCE(t.to_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Draft')
         WHERE '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.force}}' = 'Yes') AS picking_locks,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'progress_percent', x.progress_percent, 'progress_message', x.progress_message,
                                'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message) AS CHAR)
          FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'COMPLETE_GD' AND x.correlation_id = 'GD|{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}'
         ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

		'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'update_user', d.`update_user`, 'update_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(d.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted',
		d.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id', d.`tenant_id`, 'sub_tenant_id', d.`sub_tenant_id`) AS j
  FROM document_linkage d
 WHERE d.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND d.link_status = 'Linked'
   AND d.target_doc_id IN (SELECT gl.line_so_id FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub gl WHERE gl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND gl.goods_delivery_id = {{node:code_node_GSentry.data.gdId}} AND gl.is_deleted = 0 AND gl.material_id IS NOT NULL AND gl.line_so_id IS NOT NULL

                            WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_GSentry.data.gdId}})
 ORDER BY d.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id,
       j.job_status,
       g.gd_status,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'GDC|{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) x
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_GSentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_GSpost.data.idemKey}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_GSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = {{node:code_node_GSguard.data.gdId}}
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
